plan_boundary.phase_name: Voice duration truth and five-band assessment
plan_boundary.authorization: 本文件只規劃 Phase 1。它不授權 implementation、建立或切換 branch、commit、push、deployment， 也不授權開始 Phase 2。

phase_overview.phase_name: Voice duration truth and five-band assessment
phase_overview.phase_goal: 將已同步寫入 accepted voice transcript turn 的 speaking duration，轉成唯一、deterministic、 evidence-backed 的 root-answer duration assessment，提供 Phase 4 score composition 與 Phase 6 coaching 使用，但本 phase 不改變 overall score 或 candidate-facing UI。
phase_overview.observable_end_state: 每個 accepted question-answer pair 都有明確 root/follow-up identity；每個 eligible root voice answer 都有相同 shape 的 { eligible, reason, seconds, level, earnedPoints, maxPoints }；text、follow-up、 missing/unreliable duration 都是 not applicable，不會被轉成 0 分；report metrics 只 aggregate eligible roots；現有 overall score 保持完全不變。

task_contract.one_observable_goal: 對 report dataset 中每個 eligible accepted root voice answer，從該 answer turn 自己的 transcript metadata 產出且只產出一個 exact five-band duration assessment；任何 ineligible 或 missing-system-evidence case 產出 not-applicable contract，不影響 current overall score。

forbidden_areas.area: question catalogs、semantic framework routing、turnRubric framework identity。

task_contract.stop_rule: 若 implementation forecast 超過 10 task-owned files 或 500 incremental lines，或必須改 voice runtime、 public report contract、overall score 才能完成 Phase 1，立即停止並提出 phase split；不可自行擴 scope。

source_contract.valid_duration: Number(value) 必須 finite 且大於 0；保留 analyzer 寫入的兩位小數，不先 round 成整數。

prohibited_sources.source: frontend timer 或 text typing duration

eligible_when.condition: answer 已由 buildReportTurnDataset 配對成 accepted questionAnswerPair。
answerTurn.metadata.inputMode 是 realtime_voice 或 duplex_voice。

not_applicable_when.condition: questionTurnKind 是 follow_up 或其他非 root kind。
inputMode 缺失或不是兩個 current voice modes。
voice mode 正確，但 duration 缺失、null、NaN、Infinity、0 或負數。

eligibility_contract.excluded_before_assessment: repair、transcript confirmation/response、clarification、question-scope clarification、repeat request、system、 bridge acknowledgement、acknowledgement、candidate question，以及 pending/rejected/unconfirmed answer， 都沿用 reportTurnDatasetService 的 accepted-answer boundary，不建立 scored pair，也不建立 duration penalty。
eligibility_contract.substantive_definition: Phase 1 將「substantive」操作化為已通過 transcript gate 且進入 accepted questionAnswerPair 的 answer。 不新增另一個 word-count、character-count 或 LLM substantiveness threshold。

assessment_object_contract.eligible_shape: { eligible: true, reason: 'eligible_root_voice_answer', seconds: <finite positive number>, level: <1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5>, earnedPoints: <0 | 2.5 | 5 | 7.5 | 10>, maxPoints: 10 }
assessment_object_contract.not_applicable_shape: { eligible: false, reason: <stable reason code>, seconds: null, level: null, earnedPoints: null, maxPoints: 10 }
assessment_object_contract.negative_constraint: not applicable 的 earnedPoints 必須是 null，不可用 0；只有 eligible Level 1 才是真正 candidate-earned 0 points。

duration_band_contract.boundary_semantics: 使用 continuous, unrounded seconds。Band label 60-69 的 implementation boundary 是 60 <= seconds < 70； 其他整數 label 依相同方式延伸。這避免 69.99 被先 round 成 70。

summary_contract.shape: { eligibleAnswerCount, notApplicableAnswerCount, averageEligibleDurationSeconds, averageEligibleEarnedPoints, targetRangeAnswerCount, underTargetAnswerCount, overTargetAnswerCount, levelCounts: { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }, notApplicableReasonCounts }

aggregation_rules.rule: 所有 averages、target/under/over counts、levelCounts 只看 eligible assessments。
average 保留兩位小數；eligible count 為 0 時 average 是 null，不是 0。
underTarget 是 seconds < 90；target range 是 90 <= seconds <= 120；overTarget 是 seconds > 120。
notApplicableReasonCounts 只作 internal diagnostics，不變成 candidate penalty。
不得建立 top-level interviewMetrics.averageAnswerDurationSeconds 或 overlongAnswerCount；現有 frontend 會把 100 秒誤判為 overlong，Phase 6 才一起修正 public coaching contract。

work_phase.name: Baseline and acceptance-to-test lock
work_phase.goal_of_each_phase: 在任何 production edit 前，固定 source-of-truth、allowed diff、assessment contract 與每個 acceptance criterion 的 test owner。
work_phase.implementation_details: 先建立 test matrix，不修改 scoring implementation。Fixture 必須使用 current transcript shapes：AI question metadata 帶 turnKind/followUpDepth，user answer metadata 帶 inputMode、turnType、countsAsAnswer、transcriptAcceptance、voiceDelivery。
work_phase.pseudocode:
READ the three existing focused test files and their fixture conventions. CREATE one shared local test helper inside the new test file only if it removes repeated construction of: - a root/follow-up AI question turn; - an accepted user answer turn; - metadata.voiceDelivery.speakingDurationSeconds. DO NOT add a production fixture abstraction for three test files.
MAP: AC01 source conversion -> voiceDeliveryAnalyzerRobustness.test.js AC02 exact bands/decimal edges -> voiceDurationAssessmentService.test.js AC03 root/follow-up/text/missing eligibility -> voiceDurationAssessmentService.test.js AC04 raw excluded turns never become assessments -> reportTurnDatasetRobustness.test.js AC05 eligible-only summary -> voiceDurationAssessmentService.test.js AC06 same object reaches deterministic breakdown -> voiceDurationAssessmentService.test.js AC07 current overall score unchanged -> voiceDurationAssessmentService.test.js AC08 docs and no forbidden-file diff -> verification commands, not runtime unit tests
work_phase.tests_required_for_this_phase: Test names與 expected values 必須在 implementation 前明確；不需要先跑 full backend suite。
work_phase.observable_outcome: 每個 acceptance criterion 都有唯一 primary automated check；沒有 “manual inspection only” 的核心 scoring rule。
work_phase.completion_criteria: Test matrix 完整、fixtures 不依 provider/DB/time、allowed diff 沒有 overlap。

work_phase.name: Pure duration policy service
work_phase.goal_of_each_phase: 建立唯一 deterministic owner，將 per-turn root/mode/duration evidence 映射為 not-applicable 或 exact Level 1-5 assessment。
work_phase.implementation_details: Service 不讀 transcript array、不查 DB、不讀 SessionAnalysis、不呼叫 LLM/provider、不修改 input object。 Eligibility 和 band mapping 分成小 pure functions；summary 只 aggregate assessment objects，不能重讀 raw metadata。
work_phase.pseudocode:
IMPORT { ensureArray, normalizeKey } from '../../utils/commonHelpers.js'. DEFINE VOICE_INPUT_MODES = Set('realtime_voice', 'duplex_voice'). DEFINE MAX_DURATION_POINTS = 10. DEFINE LEVEL_TO_POINTS = { 1: 0, 2: 2.5, 3: 5, 4: 7.5, 5: 10 }.
FUNCTION buildNotApplicableAssessment(reason): RETURN { eligible: false, reason, seconds: null, level: null, earnedPoints: null, maxPoints: 10 }.
EXPORT FUNCTION mapVoiceDurationToLevel(rawSeconds): SET seconds = Number(rawSeconds). IF seconds is not finite OR seconds <= 0: RETURN null. DO NOT round seconds. IF seconds < 60 OR seconds > 150: RETURN 1. IF seconds < 70 OR seconds > 140: RETURN 2. IF seconds < 80 OR seconds > 130: RETURN 3. IF seconds < 90 OR seconds > 120: RETURN 4. RETURN 5.
EXPORT FUNCTION buildVoiceDurationAssessment({ questionTurnKind, answerTurn }): IF questionTurnKind !== 'root_question': RETURN buildNotApplicableAssessment('non_root_question').
SET inputMode = normalized answerTurn.metadata.inputMode. IF inputMode === 'text': RETURN buildNotApplicableAssessment('text_timing_deferred'). IF inputMode is not in VOICE_INPUT_MODES: RETURN buildNotApplicableAssessment('voice_mode_unverified').
SET seconds = Number(answerTurn.metadata.voiceDelivery.speakingDurationSeconds). SET level = mapVoiceDurationToLevel(seconds). IF level === null: RETURN buildNotApplicableAssessment('duration_evidence_unavailable').
RETURN { eligible: true, reason: 'eligible_root_voice_answer', seconds, level, earnedPoints: LEVEL_TO_POINTS[level], maxPoints: 10 }.
EXPORT FUNCTION summarizeVoiceDurationAssessments(assessments): SET all = ensureArray(assessments). SET eligible = all.filter(item => item.eligible === true). COMPUTE eligible-only average seconds and average earned points to 2 decimals, else null. COUNT eligible seconds below 90, within 90..120 inclusive, and above 120. COUNT eligible levels 1..5. COUNT all ineligible stable reason codes. RETURN the exact summary_contract shape.
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: - Do not infer seconds from word count. - Do not use deliveryConfidence/asrConfidence as a candidate-quality score. - Do not convert missing evidence into Level 1. - Do not export a second percentage/overall score.

tests_required_for_this_phase.test: Assert null/undefined/NaN/Infinity/0/negative duration 是 not applicable，不是 Level 1。
Assert text、unverified mode、follow-up 各自得到 stable reason code 與 null points。
Assert 100 seconds 是 Level 5、10 points、targetRange，且不是 overTarget。
Parameterize root question families self_intro、past example、scenario、knowledge、motivation；同一 100-second voice evidence 必須得到相同 Level 5，證明 duration rule 不讀 content framework。

work_phase.observable_outcome: 對相同 input object 重複呼叫得到 deep-equal output；所有 boundaries 無 overlap、無 gap。
work_phase.completion_criteria: Pure service focused tests 全部通過，且 file 沒有 DB/model/provider import。

work_phase.name: Accepted-pair and root/follow-up integration
work_phase.goal_of_each_phase: 讓 canonical report dataset 對每個 accepted pair 計算一次 assessment，同時沿用現有 turn exclusions，避免第二份 eligibility logic。
work_phase.implementation_details: 將目前 boolean isCountableQuestion 的 single-turn buildQuestionHistory result 保留下來，避免同一 turn 重算後 又自行猜 root/follow-up。Pending question 同時保存 raw turn 與 canonical history entry；pairing semantics 不變。
work_phase.pseudocode:
IMPORT { buildVoiceDurationAssessment, summarizeVoiceDurationAssessments } from './voiceDurationAssessmentService.js'.
REPLACE private boolean-only countable helper with: FUNCTION resolveCountableQuestionEntry(turn): IF role is not AI/assistant/interviewer: RETURN null. SET [entry] = buildQuestionHistory([turn]).countableQuestions. RETURN entry OR null.
IN buildReportTurnDataset(transcript): KEEP the current EXCLUDED_USER_TURN_TYPES and isAcceptedAnswer logic unchanged. CHANGE pendingQuestion from raw turn to { turn, historyEntry }.
FOR each transcript turn: SET countableEntry = resolveCountableQuestionEntry(turn). IF countableEntry exists: APPEND raw turn to countableQuestions. SET pendingQuestion = { turn, historyEntry: countableEntry }. CONTINUE.
IF turn is not accepted OR pendingQuestion is null: CONTINUE.
SET questionTurnKind = pendingQuestion.historyEntry.turnKind. SET voiceDurationAssessment = buildVoiceDurationAssessment({ questionTurnKind, answerTurn: turn }). APPEND pair { questionId: resolveQuestionId(pendingQuestion.turn), questionTurn: pendingQuestion.turn, answerTurn: turn, questionTurnKind, voiceDurationAssessment }. SET pendingQuestion = null.
AFTER pairing: SET voiceDurationAssessmentSummary = summarizeVoiceDurationAssessments( questionAnswerPairs.map(pair => pair.voiceDurationAssessment) ). RETURN every existing dataset field unchanged, plus voiceDurationAssessmentSummary.
DO NOT: - add repair/confirmation/candidate-question assessments outside questionAnswerPairs; - clear pending root on a non-countable clarification turn; - treat a countable follow-up as root; - pair one answer to more than one question; - mutate transcript turns.

tests_required_for_this_phase.test: Accepted root realtime_voice answer at 100 seconds produces one eligible Level 5 pair。
Accepted follow_up answer with valid 30-second duration remains a pair but assessment is non_root_question/null points。
Question-scope request、AI clarification、then root answer preserves original root pair；only root answer is eligible。
Unconfirmed low-confidence、repair response、acknowledgement、candidate question create no pair and no duration assessment。
Confirmed low-confidence original answer that satisfies accepted-answer metadata can be assessed; ASR confidence itself does not reduce duration level。
Text answer with accidental voiceDelivery field is text_timing_deferred。

work_phase.observable_outcome: dataset.questionAnswerPairs length 仍等於 accepted scored-answer count；duration summary denominator 只等於 eligible root voice answers。
work_phase.completion_criteria: 所有既有 dataset tests 保持通過，新 exclusions/follow-up cases 通過；repairTurnCount、countableQuestionCount、 scoredAnswerCount semantics 沒有 regression。

work_phase.name: Report metrics and score-ready handoff
work_phase.goal_of_each_phase: 將同一 canonical assessment 暴露到 internal report metrics 與 deterministic turn breakdown，供後續 phase 使用， 同時證明 Phase 1 不改 overall score。
work_phase.implementation_details: buildInterviewMetrics 只投影 nested summary。buildDeterministicTurnBreakdowns 只 copy pair object，不重新讀 metadata、 不重新算 band。Deterministic measured evidence 的優先權高於 model coaching output。
work_phase.pseudocode:
IN buildInterviewMetrics(transcriptOrDataset, totalQuestions): IMPORT summarizeVoiceDurationAssessments from '../../report/voiceDurationAssessmentService.js'. KEEP all existing metrics unchanged. ADD: voiceDurationAssessmentSummary: dataset.voiceDurationAssessmentSummary OR summarizeVoiceDurationAssessments( dataset.questionAnswerPairs.map(pair => pair.voiceDurationAssessment) ). DO NOT add averageAnswerDurationSeconds or overlongAnswerCount at the metrics root.
IN buildDeterministicTurnBreakdowns(transcriptOrPairs, analysedAnswers): DESTRUCTURE each pair as { questionTurn, answerTurn, voiceDurationAssessment }. COPY `voiceDurationAssessment: voiceDurationAssessment || null` into that same turn breakdown. DO NOT call buildVoiceDurationAssessment here.
IN mergeTurnBreakdownsWithRubrics(candidateTurns, deterministicTurns): SET merged.voiceDurationAssessment = fallback.voiceDurationAssessment || null. IGNORE any model-supplied duration assessment/seconds/points. KEEP deterministic question-answer identity alignment unchanged.
LEAVE runReportGeneratorAgent execution order unchanged: turnDataset -> analysedAnswers -> interviewMetrics -> deterministicTurnBreakdowns -> reportScores.
LEAVE reportScoreService.js unchanged. LEAVE buildReportDraft public sections/copy unchanged. LEAVE schemaHelpers.js candidate-facing turn normalization unchanged until Phase 6.

tests_required_for_this_phase.test: buildInterviewMetrics exposes exact eligible/not-applicable counts and averages from dataset summary。

Injected stale latestVoiceDeliverySummary/aggregate-like fields cannot override pair-derived summary；nested summary exists but legacy top-level averageAnswerDurationSeconds/overlongAnswerCount do not。
buildDeterministicTurnBreakdowns returns the exact same assessment object values as the pair。
mergeTurnBreakdownsWithRubrics keeps deterministic assessment when model candidate turn omits or forges duration fields。
computeInterviewPerformanceScore with and without added duration assessment returns the same score in Phase 1。
Text-only dataset has eligibleAnswerCount 0、null averages、no score penalty。

work_phase.observable_outcome: Internal report draft 的 interviewMetrics 有 nested canonical summary；Phase 4 可以從 deterministic turn breakdown 使用同一 object；candidate projection/UI 沒有新增 field 或 copy；current overall score bit-for-bit 不變。
work_phase.completion_criteria: Assessment 只計算一次、後續 consumers 只 copy/read；score non-mutation test 通過；reportScoreService diff 為空。

work_phase.name: Bounded docs, verification, and independent audit
work_phase.goal_of_each_phase: 用 focused automated evidence、task-scoped diff 與一次 independent audit 證明 Phase 1 contract 完成， 同時準確記錄尚未驗證的 live/browser/release gates。
work_phase.implementation_details: 文件只能記錄實際落盤 code 與實際執行結果。不可預先寫 pass count、live accuracy、provider evidence、 browser evidence 或 production readiness。F-34 不重寫歷史，不修改無關 Feature RFC。
work_phase.tests_required_for_this_phase: Focused Vitest、backend ESLint、XML/task diff checks、documentation diff inspection，以及 one independent T3 scoring-boundary audit；不跑 real AI eval、live voice、browser 或 full quality:all。
work_phase.observable_outcome: Focused commands exit 0；task diff 只包含 9 forecast paths；forbidden runtime/score/frontend files 無 diff； auditor final evidence matrix 無 blocking finding；docs 的 NOT RUN boundary 清楚。
work_phase.completion_criteria: 所有 automated criteria pass、F-34/change-log 同步完成、auditor final matrix 支持 PASS，且未做 commit/push/release。

risks_assumptions_and_decisions.assumption: Current realtime/duplex accepted transcript turn 同步包含 inputMode 與 voiceDelivery.speakingDurationSeconds。
SessionAnalysis aggregate 是 background-derived 且 eligibility-blind，因此不是 canonical score source。
只有 substantive root voice answer 適用；substantive 由 accepted-pair gate 操作化，不新增第二個 quality threshold。
Text timing deferred；missing/unreliable system duration 不可 penalize candidate。
因 source 保留兩位小數，owner 的 integer-labelled bands 以 continuous intervals 實作，不先 round seconds。
speakingDurationSeconds 是 VAD-reported speaking duration，不等同完整 wall-clock answer duration； Phase 1 focused tests 只證明 deterministic processing，不證明 browser/provider measurement accuracy。
risks_assumptions_and_decisions.decision: Per-turn transcript metadata outranks persisted aggregate summary。
Eligibility order 是 non-root -> text -> unverified voice mode -> unavailable duration -> band mapping。
Current recognized voice modes 只列 realtime_voice 與 duplex_voice；未知 mode fail closed 為 N/A。
not-applicable object 使用 null points；不重用 Level 1 的 0 points。
Phase 1 summary 放在 nested voiceDurationAssessmentSummary；不發布 current frontend 會誤讀的 legacy top-level fields。
Phase 1 產生 10-point assessment input，但 overall composition 只在 Phase 4 做一次。
Phase 1 不修 60-90/under-90 coaching copy，因為 feature 不單獨 release；Phase 6 必須在 final release 前消除它。
No database migration：raw report/interviewMetrics 現為 object/Mixed boundary；public per-turn allowlist 延後 Phase 6。
Docs outcome 是 one owning Feature RFC plus one scoped change-log；不做 reader-guide/milestone sweep。
risks_assumptions_and_decisions.risk: 若誤用 latestVoiceDeliverySummary，completion report 可能讀到 stale data，且會混入 follow-up/repair turns。 Forbidden-source test/review；只讀 pair answer metadata。
將 missing duration 設為 0 會把 system failure 變成 candidate Level 1。 Null-points contract、negative tests、auditor evidence matrix。
提前把 earnedPoints 加到 reportScoreService 會造成 partial release 或未來 double count。 reportScoreService read-only guard、score before/after test、Phase 4 owner boundary。

Follow-up metadata 若來源不完整，root/follow-up classification 可能錯。 重用 buildQuestionHistory，不以 wording 猜測；current-mode fixtures 覆蓋 explicit turnKind/followUpDepth；unknown future metadata 需在 Phase 2/5 contract 解決。
Existing frontend >90 heuristic 會把 100 seconds 誤判 overlong。 Phase 1 不發布它會讀的 top-level fields、不單獨 release；Phase 6 是 final-release blocker。
Decimal boundary 若先 round 會改變 69.99/120.01 等結果。 Continuous unrounded contract 與 decimal edge table tests。
New summary fields 可能被誤稱為 calibrated assessment accuracy。 Docs 明確標示 deterministic rule verification only；human calibration 延後 Phase 8。
risks_assumptions_and_decisions.remaining_human_decisions: Research gate 已解決 Phase 1 所需的 weights、bands、eligibility、text boundary、release strategy。 若 implementation source evidence 與本 plan 衝突，必須停止並重新 grill owner；目前沒有問題需要 owner 回答。
